title: Communist Propaganda Found In Ypoo And Louza Districts

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 25,000-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. November 15, 1933

Subject (in full) Communist Propaganda found in Y'poo and Louza Districts.

Made by D.I. Kuh Tao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Intelligence Sent of 15/11-33

During the afternoon of November 11 two small red flags bearing the insignia of the Union of Soviet Socialistic Republics were found by the Municipal Police on Kwangshin and Linching Roads respectively.

A number of coloured leaflets printed in the Chinese language were found by the Municipal Police on Nanking Road near Fokien Road at 4.70 p.m. November 11. The leaflets, which are believed to have emanated from communistic sources, denounce the Kuomintang as being in league with foreign imperialists and state that the task of overthrowing the imperialists in China rests with the Red Army.

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]
[Signature] 9/12

Li.
The above is covered in L.R. 56/33

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号。
S.2，特别股。
报告
日期：1933年11月15日

主题（全称）：在杨树浦和老闸区发现的共产主义宣传品。

呈报人：督察长 顾道华 (Kuh Tao-hwa) 转呈 [签名]

情报发送于 1933年11月15日

11月11日下午，工部局警务人员分别在广新路与临清路发现两面印有苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟徽章的小红旗。

11月11日下午4时70分[原文如此]，工部局警务人员在靠近福建路的南京路上发现若干彩色中文传单。据信这些传单出自共产主义来源，谴责国民党与外国帝国主义勾结，并声称在中国推翻帝国主义的任务在于红军。

顾道华 (Kuh Tao-hwa)
督察长

特别股主管警官。
[签名]
[签名] 12/9

李。
上述内容已涵盖于 L.R. 56/33
[签名]
